images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: environment art-direction paintover for an existing stylized 3D game, wide 16:9 image. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual game screenshot. Preserve its exact camera, perspective, building footprint, wall heights, pillars, inclined broken roof beams, broad entry staircase, summoning platform, distant bridges and terrain silhouettes. Produce a convincing refined paintover of THIS SAME scene, not a new architectural design. Main request: harmonize architecture materials, wall foliage and environment as one coherent art direction, inspired by the simplified shapes and visual quiet of The Witness. The architecture is a near-future abandoned ivory concrete megastructure, not an ancient temple. Keep its crisp large-scale forms legible. Replace sterile uniform white with restrained warm ivory/chalk material, subtle broad tonal variation, sparse large construction joints that follow the structure, delicate water staining only below exposed edges and slightly softened weathered edges. NO square tile grid, no noisy grunge, no busy cracks. Redesign wall vegetation as naturally attached, asymmetrical colonies of overlapping simplified painted leaf CLUSTERS. Broad coherent mid-green masses, unified shaded interiors, sparse lighter leaves on lit edges; tapered irregular hanging edges, occasional openings showing the wall. Leaves should be graphic pointed oval silhouettes, no visible stems or branches, no leaf veins, no photorealistic surface texture. Avoid flower-like radial rosettes, repetitive clover shapes, identical hanging triangles, evenly spaced garlands, inflated spherical clumps. Place a few unequal growth areas responding to exposed wall caps, recessed corners and ledges, with a single larger focal colony on the high wall and smaller connected patches on the low front walls; preserve generous bare architectural surface. Show convincing contact between vegetation and building with very restrained contact shadow, not dark pasted-on outlines. Integrate foliage hues with surrounding lime/olive trees and straw grass. Refine environmental lighting to clear soft daylight, warm ivory highlights, cool soft shadow planes, calm blue sky, moderate saturation and controlled exposure so white walls retain form. Existing stylized tree canopies remain simple sculptural painted shapes; grass reads as broad soft golden areas rather than noisy overexposed blades. Balanced subtle atmospheric depth. The result must still look achievable in the current stylized game, not photorealistic concept painting. Preserve existing tiny blue hologram if visible; add no people, statues, objects, ornaments, vines with woody stems, text, labels, UI, logos or watermark.
